subworkflows.name: Compute Total Energy for Defective Material

template.name: pw_scf.in

subworkflows.name: Fetch Total Energy for Pristine Material

units.name: assert-te-bulk
units.errorMessage: Pristine total energy not found. Run a Total Energy workflow on the pristine material before running Defect Formation Energy.

units.name: assign-elements
units.value:
sorted(list(set(
    [e['value'] for e in MATERIAL.basis.elements]
    + ([e['value'] for e in PRISTINE.basis.elements] if PRISTINE else [])
)))

units.name: assign-element-materials-by-symbol
assign-element-material-ids-by-symbol
units.value: {el: [m['exabyteId'] for m in ELEMENT_MATERIALS_BY_SYMBOL[el]] for el in ELEMENTS}

units.name: assign-element-materials
units.value: {el: ELEMENT_MATERIALS_BY_SYMBOL[el][0] for el in ELEMENTS if ELEMENT_MATERIALS_BY_SYMBOL[el]}

units.name: assign-missing-elemental-material-symbols
units.value: [el for el in ELEMENTS if not ELEMENT_MATERIAL_IDS_BY_SYMBOL[el]]

units.name: assert-elemental-materials-found
units.errorMessage: Missing Standata elemental reference material(s) for {{ MISSING_ELEMENTAL_MATERIAL_SYMBOLS | join(', ') }}. Add elemental material(s) with tags elemental and metadata.element before running Defect Formation Energy.

subworkflows.name: Resolve Total Energies for Elemental Materials

params.query: {'exabyteId': {'$in': ELEMENT_MATERIAL_IDS_BY_SYMBOL[CURRENT_ELEMENT]}, 'slug': 'total_energy', 'group': GROUP_FOR_MATERIAL, 'owner.slug': {'$in': [JOB_OWNER_SLUG, 'curators']}} if SOURCE_OF_TE_FOR_AN_ELEMENT == 'my_account' else ({'exabyteId': {'$in': ELEMENT_MATERIAL_IDS_BY_SYMBOL[CURRENT_ELEMENT]}, 'slug': 'total_energy', 'group': GROUP_FOR_MATERIAL, 'owner.slug': 'curators'} if SOURCE_OF_TE_FOR_AN_ELEMENT == 'curators' else {'exabyteId': {'$in': ELEMENT_MATERIAL_IDS_BY_SYMBOL[CURRENT_ELEMENT]}, 'slug': 'total_energy', 'group': GROUP_FOR_MATERIAL})

units.name: assign-te-for-elemental-materials-map-by-symbol
units.value: {**TE_FOR_ELEMENTAL_MATERIALS_MAP_BY_SYMBOL, CURRENT_ELEMENT: DATA[0] if DATA else None}

units.name: assign-missing-te-for-element-symbols
units.value: [el for el in ELEMENTS if TE_FOR_ELEMENTAL_MATERIALS_MAP_BY_SYMBOL[el] is None]

units.name: assert-te-for-elemental-materials-found
units.errorMessage: Missing total_energy for elemental reference material(s) {{ MISSING_TE_FOR_ELEMENT_SYMBOLS | join(', ') }}. Run the QE Total Energy workflow for the corresponding Standata elemental material(s) before running this workflow.

units.name: assign-te-contributions-by-symbol
units.value:
{
    el: {
        "formula": el,
        "n_atoms": len(ELEMENT_MATERIALS[el].basis.elements),
        "is_elemental": True,
        "total_energy": TE_FOR_ELEMENTAL_MATERIALS_MAP_BY_SYMBOL[el].data.value,
        "total_energy_per_atom": TE_FOR_ELEMENTAL_MATERIALS_MAP_BY_SYMBOL[el].data.value
        / len(ELEMENT_MATERIALS[el].basis.elements),
        "precision_value": TE_FOR_ELEMENTAL_MATERIALS_MAP_BY_SYMBOL[el].precision.value,
        "precision_metric": TE_FOR_ELEMENTAL_MATERIALS_MAP_BY_SYMBOL[el].precision.metric,
    }
    for el in ELEMENTS
    if TE_FOR_ELEMENTAL_MATERIALS_MAP_BY_SYMBOL[el]
}

units.name: assign-delta-n-by-symbol
assign-sum-delta-n-times-mu
units.value:
sum(
    DELTA_N_BY_SYMBOL[el] * TE_CONTRIBUTIONS_BY_SYMBOL[el]["total_energy_per_atom"]
    for el in ELEMENTS
    if el in TE_CONTRIBUTIONS_BY_SYMBOL
)

units.name: Compute Total Energy for Defective Material
Fetch Total Energy for Pristine Material
Resolve Total Energies for Elemental Materials
